independentReview.ownerAdjudication: Retain hind-hover and burial findings. Truebones comparator is generated, authored stance is 8 frames, and low net travel alone is not a failure for an in-place prompt.

unrunOrUnqualified: Browser fixed-midpoint 10/20/50 quality and native WebGPU latency
Qualified raw stance classifier and F1-F3 gait grades
Full paper E.5 foot locking: numerical policy not specified
180-frame single-pass model: not among the inspected f60 releases
Exact paper/showcase case reproduction without original manifest and protected trajectory access
nextGate: First obtain a source-reference raw motion that meets original-skin F4 and visual requirements across at least three seeds and three real strides. Only then qualify a faster browser grid using identical initial-noise tensors and matched padded width. Do not spend a broad midpoint or CFG sweep to optimize a reference that still fails the required motion outcome.
commercialGate: HF weights declared CC BY-NC 4.0; DEC10 remains with the owner. This is a technical quality recommendation.
